lines.text: Meta's ad servers are never big enough, so it decides where every bit of computer power goes.
Some ad requests gain a lot from extra computer power. Others gain almost nothing.
lines.title: The problem

lines.text: Old rules put requests in big groups. A trained AI model now guesses the gain for each single request.
lines.title: Rules vs AI

lines.text: Each request then passes three choices: which region, which hardware, and how much of one machine.
lines.title: Three decisions

lines.text: AI agents now help tune the system. They did about twenty percent of the work, and eighty percent on the most automated part.
lines.title: AI agents at work

lines.text: Engineers still approve every change before it ships.
lines.title: Takeaways
